name: selector-columnas-csv
description: Mapper ETL: sube un CSV, elige columnas (a mano o con ayuda de Gemini) y exporta el resultado.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n servidor,cliente -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.test: npm test -w server && npm test -w client
